vms.name: LLM-T1-NC80
vms.notes: PRIMARY — this project's actual workhorse. H100 NVL x2, 880 GB RAM (northeurope, brainpowa-northeurope). Every successful GPU run in rail-arf-stt happened here: t0014, t0015, t0017 (23.1 h, $308.52). Carries the ready conda env 'stt' (NeMo 3.1.0), an HF cache with parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 / parakeet-unified-en-0.6b / granite-speech-4.1-2b, and the fine-tune checkpoints at /mnt/finetune-checkpoints/ — do not delete. Caveat: NOT a dedicated ARF box — finetuning team members (Margarita, Mohan, etc.) SSH in directly for manual work without taking an ARF lock, so requires_coordination_if_running=true: acquire() refuses it when already Running rather than silently claiming it, and only auto-acquires it when found Stopped. Ping #finetuning before long runs. This is the ONLY entry in the pool by design: FT-MC was removed on 2026-08-26 after its single use (t0024) failed on a missing env and cost $14.06 for nothing, and FT-NC80-v1/v2/v3 were removed on 2026-08-24 as decommissioned. With no fallback, acquire() writes pool_busy.md when this box is already Running — that is the intended outcome, better than silently landing a run on a box with no 'stt' env. See docs/northeurope_pool_runbook.md for the SSH alias / HostName-refresh-after-start procedure.
